sloka: गज राज गतिर् वीरः महा बाहुर् धनुर् धरः ।वनम् आविशते नूनम् सभार्यः सह लक्ष्मणः ॥२-४३-६॥
transliteration: gaja rāja gatir vīraḥ mahā bāhur dhanur dharaḥ ।vanam āviśate nūnam sabhāryaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ ॥2-43-6॥

translations.english: My mightyarmed son, a great archer and a hero, Rama whose gait is like that of the king of elephants, must be entering the forest along with his consort Sita and Lakshmana.
